data.name: Tidy Up the Royal Armory
data.detailed_description:
THE ROYAL ARMORY HASN’T BEEN INSPECTED IN 20 YEARS

You have been its keeper for 19 of them.

This does not look good.

Swords are on the wrong racks. Shields have disappeared beneath piles of equipment. Priceless royal weapons are scattered across the halls and after nearly two decades of confidently deciding to deal with it later, the Crown has finally announced an inspection.

It’s time to tidy up.

MARSHMALLOW IS HERE TO HELP

Marshmallow is a faithful dog with limitless enthusiasm and a developing understanding of his job. His early contributions may be questionable, but his abilities improve alongside your own.

Teach Marshmallow how to help with the growing workload. With enough practice, he may become the finest four-legged armory keeper in the kingdom.

He is still a dog. Manage your expectations.

TURN CHAOS INTO ORDER

Explore the ancient armory and return every sword, axe, spear, bow and shield to its rightful place.

Examine the weapons, identify matching sets and organize the collection one rack at a time. Watch cluttered floors reappear and chaotic piles become immaculate displays worthy of the royal armory.

TURN COMPLETED RACKS INTO MAGIC

Restoring weapon sets earns magical abilities that make the enormous cleanup easier by summoning matching items from elsewhere in the armory directly into your hands or shelving them automatically.

Improve each spell as the restoration continues. Stronger magic helps you search larger areas and spend less time retracing your steps.

Use spells whenever you need them, or rely on your own knowledge of the collection.

ENJOY THE SATISFACTION

Clear crowded floors. Complete rows of matching weapons. Restore forgotten chambers and watch the armory slowly return to its former glory.

Every correctly placed weapon makes the mess smaller, the halls more beautiful and the approaching inspection slightly less terrifying.

A COZY FANTASY ORGANIZING GAME

Leave battles and heroic quests to the adventurers. Your challenge is quieter—but no less important.

Surrounded by ancient stone, warm lantern light and rows of legendary weapons, settle into a cozy organizing experience about patience, progression and the simple pleasure of putting everything exactly where it belongs.

The King is coming.

Marshmallow is ready to help.

Now tidy up the Royal Armory!

AI USAGE

Every single model and texture in the game is handcrafted by real humans.

data.short_description: The Crown is inspecting the Royal Armory for the first time in 20 years. You have spent 19 of them ignoring the mess. Return thousands of scattered items, each modeled by hand, to their rightful racks in this cozy fantasy organizing game, with your faithful dog Marshmallow by your side.
